data: Microsoft's net income rose from $72,738 million in fiscal 2022 (year ended June 30, 2022) to $88,136 million in fiscal 2024 (year ended June 30, 2024), an increase of $15,398 million, or about 21.2%. The path was not smooth: net income dipped slightly to $72,361 million in fiscal 2023 before rebounding in fiscal 2024, when revenue reached $245,122 million versus $198,270 million in fiscal 2022.
